'''Henri Bacry''' (1928–2010) was Professor Emeritus at the [[Université de la Méditerranée]]. Henri Bacry was assistant of [[physics]] at the [[Faculté des Sciences d'Alger]] and then Professor of [[mathematics]] at [[Lycée Bugeaud]], before becoming, in 1969, Professor at the [[Faculté des Sciences de Luminy]]. He was a visiting scholar at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] in Princeton in 1966-6<ref>[http://www.ias.edu/people/cos/frontpage?page=7 Institute for Advanced Study: A Community of Scholars] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130106144411/http://www.ias.edu/people/cos/frontpage?page=7 |date=2013-01-06 }}</ref> and a researcher at [[CERN]]. He is the founder in 1972 of the [https://web.archive.org/web/20090218015402/http://www.ccr.jussieu.fr/group24/ International Colloquium of Group Theoretical Methods in Physics]. He has numerous publications on theoretical physics, problems of symmetry in various fields ranging from [[de Sitter invariant special relativity|relativity]] to [[particle physics]], [[optics]], physics of [[sound]] and [[statistical mechanics]] and some work in [[mathematics]]. 

==Selected publications==
* with [[Jean-Marc Lévy-Leblond]] ''Possible Kinematics'', J. Math. Phys., vol. 9, 1969, pp. 1605–1614 {{doi|10.1063/1.1664490}} (discussed by [[Freeman Dyson]] his 1972 Gibbs Lecture [https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1972-78-05/S0002-9904-1972-12971-9/home.html ''Missed opportunities''])
* [https://projecteuclid.org/download/pdf_1/euclid.cmp/1103907654 ''Constellations and projective classical groups''], Comm. Math. Pays., vol. 72, 1980, pp. 119–130 {{doi|10.1007/BF01197631}}
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=WwcXg2cpLa4C Group theory and constellations]. Editions Publibook, 2004.
